funder_says: The measure name is a Rozporzadzenie - a Polish ministerial regulation of 9 November 2015. It is the legal basis on which PARP was allowed to grant aid under Program Operacyjny Wiedza Edukacja Rozwoj; it is not itself a call, and no company has ever applied to a Rozporzadzenie. The naborow that ran under it were PARP's POWER calls. POWER 2014-2020 is finished and PARP's live equivalent is Fundusze Europejskie dla Rozwoju Spolecznego 2021-2027, which the PARP FERS site shows with open calls, e.g. Akademia HR closing 30 listopada 2026.
